description: This file defines an interface (IRemoteInstantiation) for remote instantiation of components within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It declares a virtual method Instantiate for creating remote instances with various parameters.

classes.name: IRemoteInstantiation
classes.description: An interface for remote instantiation of components, providing a method to instantiate components remotely with specified parameters.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates a remote instance of a component with specified parameters such as library name, class name, callsign, interface ID, version, user, group, system root path, thread count, priority, and configuration.
